season.title: The first HoopConnect season in Poland.
season.descPrefix: Compete every week — workouts, games and achievements all add up to league points. The league resets every Monday at 00:00. To join, you need to be active for
season.descSuffix: — you then enter at the start of the next week.

status.notEligibleBody: You need your first weekly report — stay active for 7 days to join the league.

tiers.label: Bronze
tiers.sub: Start training and earn points toward a higher league.

tiers.label: Silver
tiers.sub: Stay active for a few weeks.

tiers.label: Gold
tiers.desc: An engaged player following the plan.
tiers.sub: At least 70% of planned workouts weekly.

tiers.label: Platinum
tiers.sub: Regular participation in sessions and club meetups.

tiers.label: Diamond
tiers.sub: Only for players fully committed every week.

pointSources.label: Club match
pointSources.sub: Played and confirmed team match · max 3 per day

pointSources.label: Shooting session
pointSources.sub: Completed session logged in the app

pointSources.label: Workout (100% of plan)
pointSources.sub: All exercises for the day marked as done

pointSources.label: Weekly streak
pointSources.sub: Bonus for each consecutive week of activity

rules.title: 7-day tenure
rules.body: You need your first weekly report to join the league

rules.title: Starts on Mon.
rules.body: You always enter at the start of a new week — not mid-week

rules.title: Fair play
rules.body: Workouts count with a ×0.5 multiplier · matches and shooting ×1.0

rules.title: Match limit
rules.body: Max 3 matches per day · points awarded once the result is confirmed

rules.title: Match cooldown
rules.body: 3v3 / 5v5 — min. 75 min apart · 2v2 — min. 45 min apart
